hero.title: For the love of complexity
hero.lead: We are facilitators of social systems change. Today’s complexity offers fantastic opportunities for creativity, innovation and collaboration. By embracing complexity, we can create our desired future together.

work.label: What we do
work.title: How can we help you?
work.intro: We bring people with different knowledge, interests and perspectives together. This is how we create space for new insights and responses to the complex challenges we are facing.

services.title: Facilitation of multi-stakeholder processes
services.text: We facilitate dialogue with diverse stakeholders around shared challenges. Strengthening common ground and including diverse perspectives brings depth, new insights and room for collective action.

services.title: Narrative research and evaluation
services.text: To unravel patterns in complexity, we use the power of stories for research and evaluation, in a participatory and inclusive way. We help you learn from the past and decide for the future.

services.title: Leadership and capacity strengthening
services.text: To help you and your organisation navigate complexity, we offer group training and coaching on the job, with tools and methods for complex situations.

navigator.label: Our vision and tool
navigator.title: The Complexity Navigator
navigator.subtitle: nine building blocks for collective impact in complexity
navigator.text: To navigate complexity and create collective impact, you need to pay attention to nine crucial aspects. These building blocks help you unravel your specific situation and find your starting point for action. The Navigator is based on proven methods and our years of collective experience.

tools.label: Our tools
tools.title: Made by Perspectivity
tools.intro: Two tools that grew out of our work, now used far beyond it.

sprockler.title: Stories and stats, connected in one tool
sprockler.text: Sprockler is our online tool for narrative research. People share a story and interpret it themselves; the patterns appear right away in interactive graphs, with the individual stories at the heart of every graph. Used in evaluations from Timor-Leste to Amsterdam.

challenge.title: A serious board game about complexity
challenge.text: In The Perspectivity Challenge, players act as world leaders and experience complexity first-hand, then reflect on what they learned. Games on climate, food, public health, fashion, human security and decision making. Played in 24 countries, by 83 organisations.

training.label: Training
training.title: Learn to navigate complexity
training.intro: Learn how to facilitate a generative dialogue, use the value of different perspectives, or conduct narrative and participatory research. Open enrolment, or tailor-made for your organisation.
training.note: Perspectivity Enterprise is CRKBO registered; our training courses are VAT exempt.

quote: “Perspectivity’s work is based on human contact and social structures. Human contact is a whimsical process. It can rub, explode, unite or run smoothly.”

team.label: Who we are
team.title: A cooperative of facilitators
team.intro: Perspectivity is a steward-owned cooperative of professionals who join forces to navigate complexity. We live and work in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and beyond. Are you an independent professional looking for like-minded spirits? Let’s have a virtual coffee.

contact.title: Let’s talk
contact.text: Working on a complex challenge? We like to think along. Send us a message, or sign up for our newsletter about our work, trainings and events.
